entry.summary:
Author: sakuraflames

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 22,724Chapters: 6/?Kudos: 40

Summary: Tim and Damian accidentally get trapped inside a magical Dungeons & Dragons campaign. The quests are deadly. The NPCs have their own stories. The monsters don't always stay dead. And the mysterious being known as The Eye has been watching players fail for a very, very long time. Meanwhile, Gotham's rescue team has exactly one option: Roll initiative. in which, Bruce accidentally becomes a Dungeon Master. Jason is alarmingly competent. Dick keeps trying to fix everyone's feelings. Jon and Conner start a custody battle over which Robin is the bigger disaster. Tim acquires trauma, alchemy, and approximately seventeen migraines. Damian discovers that magic is inefficient, dragons are possessive, and feelings are somehow the hardest boss fight.
